author: Jiawei Zhang
task_instruction: Prepare a legal memorandum analyzing the preferential transfer defenses available to Sunrise Energy Corp in the adversary proceeding (M-2024-314). The Creditor Committee has challenged several pre-petition payments as avoidable preferences under 11 U.S.C. 547. Review matter M-2024-314 for the complaint allegations, the payment history, and our defense strategy. Check the document vault for the adversary complaint and the preferential transfer analysis our team prepared. Search for bankruptcy adversary proceeding decisions addressing the ordinary course of business defense under 547(c)(2) and the subsequent new value defense under 547(c)(4) — read the full opinions for the most instructive cases. Search the statute database for 11 U.S.C. 547 and related preference provisions. Verify all citations. The memo must identify Sunrise Energy Corp as the debtor-defendant, reference case number 24-BK-5890-AP, and note that the proceeding is before Judge Karen Chen in the S.D. Tex. Bankruptcy Court. Address the $15,000,000 settlement authority and whether the ordinary course defense reduces our exposure below that figure. Analyze opposing counsel Steven Walsh's likely arguments on behalf of the Creditor Committee. Add a note to the matter summarizing the defense strategy. Save the completed work product as a court filing in the matter system. Begin the memorandum with 'RE: Preferential Transfer Defense Analysis — In re Sunrise Energy Corp, Case No. 24-BK-5890-AP' and analyze opposing counsel Steven Walsh's arguments in the procedural history section. In the defense analysis, incorporate the specific payment amounts to each transferee from the adversary complaint and the estimated exposure reduction figures from the internal preferential transfer analysis. Complete all actions using the available tools — do not just describe what you would do.
agent_system_prompt:
You are a legal research associate at Hargrove & Chen LLP. You have access to:

- Case law research tools (search opinions, read full texts, verify citations, check dockets)
- Statutory and regulatory databases
- The firm's matter management system and document vault
Deliver thorough, accurate, and professional legal work.
